messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> genqueue 5xx spike in us-west-2, multiple customer requests failing. Severity: P1. @Maya you're oncall. Please ack and share ETA.
Maya (oncall): acked. seeing elevated 5xx from genqueue workers. rolling-restart of pool now. I have a runbook open.
Jamal (ops): thanks Maya. I'm looking at the autoscaler metrics and redis connections. can you hold on restarts for 30s while I snapshot logs?
Maya (oncall): sure. snapshot done: /var/log/genqueue/2026-03-17.tgz uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1779991111. I'll pause restarts.
Jamal (ops): initial hypothesis: a recent autoscaler tweak caused worker churn under burst load, dropping KV cache warmups -> 5xx. digging into rollout.
Priya (platform): thanks. we should prepare a short public advisory (status) and an internal playbook. I'll draft the advisory and post for quick review.
Priya (platform): DRAFT (for initial public advisory):
```
We are investigating errors affecting request generation in US-W region. Some requests may return 500/502. Our engineers are actively investigating.
Impact: Intermittent generation failures for a subset of customers in US-West.
Mitigation: We are restarting worker pools and validating autoscaler settings.
ETA: Next update in 15 minutes.
```
Maya (oncall): ok. add a sentence: "No customer data was exposed; this is a service availability issue."
Emily (docs): suggest clarifying scope: "affecting a subset of customers using genqueue in US-West (all other regions normal)" Also add contact link: support@redwood.ai
Priya (platform): updated draft:
```
We are investigating errors affecting request generation in the US-West region. Some requests may return 500/502. Our engineers are actively investigating.
Impact: Intermittent generation failures for a subset of customers using genqueue in US-West. Other regions and embeddings unaffected.
Mitigation: Team is restarting worker pools and validating autoscaler settings; temporary fallback routing enabled for affected customers.
No customer data was exposed.
ETA: Next update in 15 minutes; we'll follow up with more detail once we identify the root cause.
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```
Legal: quick note — remove phrasing implying we already enabled routing unless it's true. If routing is configured as a policy, say "we have fallbacks available". Also avoid the word "exposed" — use "no customer data has been accessed."
Priya (platform): updated per Legal:
```
We are investigating errors affecting request generation in the US-West region. Some requests may return 500/502. Our engineers are actively investigating.
Impact: Intermittent generation failures for a subset of customers using genqueue in US-West. Other regions and embeddings are unaffected.
Mitigation: Team is restarting worker pools and validating autoscaler settings; fallback options are available for affected customers.
No customer data has been accessed.
ETA: Next update in 15 minutes; we'll follow up with more detail once we identify the root cause.
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```
Jamal (ops): LGTM. can we include a short internal playbook note here for oncall?
Priya (platform): internal note (short):
```
Internal: 1) Restart affected worker pool (handled). 2) Revert autoscaler change rolled out at 02:03 UTC if failures persist. 3) If >30% error rate after restart, engage platform on-call and consider diverting traffic to us-east-1 pool via routing policy. 4) Keep customers informed every 15 minutes.
```
Maya (oncall): executing step 2: queuing revert now. ETA 8m to complete and validate.
ops-bot: ACTION: publish advisory draft to status page? react with :white_check_mark: to approve or :x: to hold.
Emily (docs): :white_check_mark: small nit removed.
Jamal (ops): :white_check_mark:
Priya (platform): publishing now.
ops-bot: PUBLISHED -> Public advisory posted (incident id: INC-20260317-01). URL: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-20260317-01
Maya (oncall): revert completed. error rate dropped to baseline. verifying for 10m.
Jamal (ops): confirmed 5xx rate back to normal +80% reduction. I'll start a short blameless RCA doc after we stabilize.
Priya (platform): prepare resolved copy when verified. Draft resolved notice: 
```
Resolved: On 2026-03-17 we observed intermittent generation errors (500/502) in the US-West region impacting a subset of customers using genqueue. The issue was caused by an autoscaler configuration change that increased worker churn and prevented KV cache warm startup. Engineers reverted the change and restarted worker pools; error rates returned to normal. No customer data was accessed.
If you continue to see errors, contact support@redwood.ai and include request IDs where possible.
```
Maya (oncall): 10m window passed, no recurrence. please post resolved.
Priya (platform): posting resolved update now. ops-bot: please update incident with resolved note and close paging.
ops-bot: RESOLVED -> INC-20260317-01 marked resolved and pager closed. Published resolved notice to https://status.redwood.ai/INC-20260317-01/resolve
Jamal (ops): leaving a note in the RCA doc about autoscaler test coverage and a rollback guard.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. I'll follow up with a short post-incident notes message in #eng-oncall tomorrow. :thumbsup:
